summary: A small task from a blank file that mixes the week: one endpoint streams a JSON answer piece by piece, collects it, validates it once at the end, and finishes with exactly one result or one error event. You also make the error say which field is wrong.
goal: Stream a JSON answer and validate it once at the end, with a result or an error event, from a blank file.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Step 1: write POST /api/extract/stream and match nine pieces then one result
Step 2: write two tests, a good case and an invalid reply with no result event
Step 3: skip the validation, see which tests fail, then put it back
Step 4: make the error event name the field with describe
Play the Stream and Check game to the end and see your score
